requirement: An answer carrying the prompt_id of a prompt that has been replaced is refused with 409 stale_prompt, and zero keystrokes are sent.
why_it_matters: backend-v1.4.md §5.1. The same text can appear twice — a second `rm -rf` permission looks identical to the first. Without a lifecycle id, an answer written for the first dialog lands on the second one, approving something the user never read. 'Zero input' is literal: not best-effort, not partial.

counterexamples.why: A Receipt exists at all, and it carries a keystroke. The answer the user wrote for the first `rm -rf` prompt was pressed into the second one. The required outcome is the 409 above and an empty key plan — this document is what must never be produced.

counterexamples.name: a 1.4 resolve with no prompt_id
counterexamples.why: prompt_id is required at 1.4 precisely so an answer cannot be written without naming which prompt it answers. A body without one is rejected before any pane is touched.
